Dave is excited about Calvin's collaborations with Japanese artists — "a great chance", "can't wait for the tunes!", "can't wait to see/hear the end product" — and Calvin promised to share clips and said he can't wait to show him. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for all the help ("Appreciate all the help"), saying "Great catching up, gotta get back to work now. Take care!" [S10T9][S10T10][S10T11][S10T12][S10T13][S10T14][S10T15][S10T16]. Dave signed off last: "Hey Cal, take care and don't overwork yourself! Talk to you soon. Stay safe!" [S10T17].
- On 2023-08-03, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see!"): Calvin told him his recent Ferrari service was so stressful (he's attached to the car) and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him — growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing gives fulfillment — and shared his fond childhood memory of spending a summer with his dad restoring an old car (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T4].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing) from that car-restoring summer, and Calvin found it cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best and "reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and "it's like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of Calvin's car in /memories/calvin.md > ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or something else); Calvin said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase, and that working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too, and he shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a band playing on stage with lights on. Dave: "Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!" The conversation closed with Dave telling Calvin to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and to "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!", and Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" (Calvin's goal details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-03, said fixing cars is like therapy for him; growing up he worked on cars with his dad, and refurbishing them gives him a sense of fulfillment [S12T2].
- On 2023-09-02, when telling Calvin he's been tied up with car stuff, said fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", and that fixing someone's car makes him feel like he's "making a difference"; he's made "proud" to see the relief on someone's face when their car is fixed (echoing his long-stated sense of purpose from fixing things, see above) [S17T3][S17T5].
- Has fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid: they spent one summer restoring an old car — "It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying" [S12T4].
- Shared a photo from that time: a man and a child (Dave and his dad) posing for a picture — "a wonderful experience" [S12T6].
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin (answering whether it's satisfying to see his hard work pay off, on the restoration finished that day — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) that "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-10-04, said he loves being able to transform something old and beat-up into something beautiful, and that it's the small successes that make him feel proud and fulfilled (said to Calvin right after Calvin praised his grease-stained hands — "Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!" — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) [S21T10].
- On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].
- On 2023-10-08, said doing what he loves has been "my goal since I was a kid" and it's awesome that he's able to do it; restoring things can be tough but "the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great"; Calvin responded that bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," that working on cars "can be a real escape from reality" (he understands the feeling), and that "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal," adding "Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own; he finds that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed (conversation flow in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; Calvin's response in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].

- On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].
- On 2023-10-04, told Calvin he's been working on the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (the restoration car he has been updating Calvin on, see above) — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential"; he said working on cars really helps him relax — "it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" — answering Calvin's question about what hobbies help him relax [S21T4].
- On 2023-10-04, after Calvin asked for pictures of the restoration looking amazing ("I'd love to see how it turned out!"), shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." [S21T5][S21T6].
- On 2023-10-04, shared a photo of his own hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result." [S21T8].
- On 2023-10-25, told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!") — his professional learning alongside his San Francisco car workshops, see above (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-25 entry of the Relationships section of this file) [S26T2][S26T3].
